narrative: In the account book. John's sheet of towns and carriage costs lies on the chest. A jug and a heel of bread take the corner. The miles are above. The dates are at the foot, with no sum under them.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the foot of the sheet.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Left the sheet where it was written.

entities.name: John's sheet
entities.context: Shown on ledger in Heminges's sheet of towns
